name: Cybin Inc.
warningSignals: Pre-revenue biotech with high cash burn; clinical-stage psilocybin programs (CYB003, CYB004) carry regulatory and efficacy risk
Psychedelic sector regulatory pathway remains uncertain; FDA breakthrough designation does not guarantee approval
Dependence on capital markets for funding; equity dilution risk if clinical milestones miss or market sentiment shifts
opportunitySignals: CYB003 deuterated psilocybin shows potential for improved pharmacokinetics and IP protection vs unmodified psilocybin
Psychedelic-assisted therapy market expanding; FDA breakthrough status accelerates clinical pathway for treatment-resistant depression
Intellectual property moat via deuteration chemistry; potential licensing or partnership upside with large pharma

enginesRun: Deuteration IP portfolio (6+ patent families filed)

domainRelevance: Cybin is a clinical-stage psychedelic pharmaceutical company developing deuterated psilocybin analogs (CYB003, CYB004) for treatment-resistant depression and anxiety disorders. The company's core innovation is isotopic enrichment chemistry, which aims to improve pharmacokinetics, reduce dosing frequency, and establish patent protection in a rapidly evolving psychedelic therapeutics market. Cybin's regulatory pathway is anchored by FDA Breakthrough Therapy Designation for CYB003, positioning it as a leading contender in the emerging psychedelic-assisted psychotherapy space.
portalRelevance: Cybin represents a high-risk, high-reward play in the nascent psychedelic medicine sector, which is transitioning from Schedule I research to FDA-regulated clinical development. The company's success hinges on Phase 2b efficacy data, regulatory approval timelines, and capital availability—all of which are material to understanding biotech sector stress and venture-backed pharmaceutical innovation cycles. Cybin's trajectory also signals broader institutional acceptance of psychedelic therapeutics and the viability of deuteration as a pharmaceutical optimization strategy.

notes.cohortStatus: Clinical-stage biotech; peer group includes Compass Pathways (CMPS), MindMed (MNMD), Atai Life Sciences (ATAI)

intelligenceCycle.name: Signal Capture
items: SEC 10-Q/10-K filings: cash burn rate, R&D spend, clinical trial enrollment metrics, capital raises
Clinical trial registry updates (ClinicalTrials.gov): CYB003 Phase 2b enrollment, safety/efficacy interim readouts
FDA correspondence: Breakthrough Designation status, pre-BLA meetings, regulatory feedback on deuteration chemistry
Equity capital events: secondary offerings, warrant exercises, dilution signals from insider trading patterns

intelligenceCycle.name: State Estimation
items: Cash runway estimation: quarterly burn vs. available capital; probability of capital raise requirement within 12–18 months
Clinical program phase advancement: enrollment velocity, interim data quality, regulatory milestone achievement
Competitive positioning: relative progress vs. Compass Pathways (CMPS) Phase 2b, MindMed (MNMD) Phase 2a programs
Intellectual property strength: patent grant status, freedom-to-operate risk, licensing negotiation leverage

intelligenceCycle.name: Diagnosis
items: Biotech distress signature: cash burn acceleration + failed clinical milestone + capital market closure = existential risk
Regulatory inflection: positive Phase 2b data + FDA feedback alignment = de-risking event; negative data = 40–60% drawdown risk
Sector contagion: psychedelic sector sentiment (CMPS, MNMD, ATAI price action) correlates with CYBN funding access and valuation
IP moat validation: deuteration patent strength vs. generic psilocybin; licensing interest from Roche, Eli Lilly, or other pharma signals value

intelligenceCycle.name: Regulation
items: Investment thesis: long-duration biotech call option; thesis breaks if Phase 2b misses efficacy or safety thresholds
Risk hedge: short biotech sector ETF (XBI) or long volatility (VIX calls) to hedge clinical-stage concentration risk
Capital structure monitoring: watch for dilutive equity raises, debt issuance, or warrant exercises that signal distress
Regulatory engagement: track FDA meeting minutes, breakthrough designation renewal conditions, and pre-BLA feedback

intelligenceCycle.name: Action
items: Position sizing: limit to 1–2% of portfolio; biotech stage risk warrants position-level stop-loss at 25–30% drawdown
Catalyst calendar: set alerts for Phase 2b interim data (Q2–Q3 2024), FDA meetings (quarterly), quarterly cash burn reports
Engagement: attend investor day (if held); request management guidance on capital runway, clinical timeline, partnership discussions
Hedging execution: establish short biotech sector hedge if CYBN position exceeds 2% of portfolio

intelligenceCycle.name: Feedback
items: Phase 2b data validation: compare announced efficacy/safety vs. pre-announcement consensus; assess FDA feedback tone in subsequent meetings
Capital raise tracking: monitor equity issuance terms, dilution %, and investor composition (institutional vs. insider participation)
Price action correlation: CYBN vs. CMPS, MNMD, XBI; divergence signals company-specific news or sector rotation
Filing delta: watch for changes in risk factor disclosure, clinical trial enrollment language, or cash runway estimates in 10-Q updates

intelligenceCycle.name: Adaptation
items: Recalibrate biotech phase-transition probabilities: update success rates for Phase 2b→Phase 3 based on Cybin and peer outcomes
Reweight clinical-data signal: if Phase 2b misses, downgrade efficacy-signal reliability; if exceeds, upgrade regulatory-pathway confidence
Update psychedelic-sector priors: track CMPS, MNMD, ATAI outcomes to refine sector-wide approval probability and timeline estimates
Adjust capital-access model: if Cybin raises at lower valuation, recalibrate biotech funding-environment stress assumptions

suppliers.name: Perception Neuroscience
suppliers.relationshipNote: Contract research organization (CRO) providing deuteration chemistry synthesis, analytical characterization, and preclinical pharmacology studies for CYB003 and CYB004 development. Perception Neuroscience's isotope enrichment expertise is foundational to Cybin's IP moat; relationship includes GMP manufacturing scale-up support..

suppliers.name: Pharmaceutical Product Development (PPD)
suppliers.relationshipNote: Contract research organization (CRO) managing Phase 2b CYB003 clinical trial execution, site recruitment, patient enrollment, and data management across multiple geographies. PPD's trial-management infrastructure is critical to enrollment velocity and regulatory data quality..

suppliers.name: Recro Pharma
suppliers.relationshipNote: Specialty pharmaceutical CDMO (contract development and manufacturing organization) providing GMP manufacturing, formulation development, and supply-chain logistics for Cybin's psilocybin-based compounds. Recro's capacity constraints and regulatory compliance are material to clinical trial supply continuity and commercial launch readiness..

suppliers.name: Sigma-Aldrich (Merck KGaA subsidiary)
suppliers.relationshipNote: Supplier of deuterium-enriched solvents, pharmaceutical-grade reagents, and analytical standards critical to Cybin's deuteration chemistry platform. Sigma-Aldrich's isotope inventory and quality assurance are essential to manufacturing consistency and regulatory compliance..

suppliers.name: Catalent Inc.
suppliers.relationshipNote: Global CDMO providing capsule formulation, fill-finish manufacturing, and stability testing for Cybin's psilocybin-based therapeutics. Catalent's expertise in controlled-substance handling and FDA-regulated manufacturing is critical to Phase 3 and commercial supply readiness..

suppliers.name: Charles River Laboratories
suppliers.relationshipNote: Contract research organization providing preclinical toxicology, pharmacology, and safety studies required for IND applications and regulatory submissions. Charles River's GLP-compliant testing is foundational to Cybin's regulatory dossier for CYB003 and CYB004..

suppliers.name: Parexel International
suppliers.relationshipNote: Regulatory consulting firm advising Cybin on FDA breakthrough designation strategy, IND/BLA pathway optimization, and pre-BLA meeting preparation. Parexel's FDA expertise is critical to accelerating clinical development timelines and reducing regulatory risk..

suppliers.name: Lonza Group
suppliers.relationshipNote: Swiss CDMO with expertise in controlled-substance manufacturing and scale-up. Lonza's capacity and regulatory compliance are relevant to Cybin's long-term manufacturing strategy for psilocybin-based APIs, though.

suppliers.name: Thermo Fisher Scientific
suppliers.relationshipNote: Supplier of high-performance liquid chromatography (HPLC), mass spectrometry, and analytical instrumentation used in Cybin's deuteration chemistry characterization and quality control. Thermo Fisher's analytical platforms are standard in pharmaceutical R&D..

suppliers.name: Geodis
suppliers.relationshipNote: Third-party logistics (3PL) provider offering pharmaceutical-grade warehousing, inventory management, and distribution services. Geodis's DEA-licensed facilities support Cybin's controlled-substance handling and regulatory compliance for clinical supply chain..

logisticsPartners.name: DHL Life Sciences
logisticsPartners.relationshipNote: Specialized logistics provider managing temperature-controlled, secure shipment of investigational drug product (IDP) to clinical trial sites globally. DHL's cold-chain expertise and regulatory compliance are critical to maintaining drug stability and trial integrity across Phase 2b sites..

logisticsPartners.name: FedEx Specialty Logistics
logisticsPartners.relationshipNote: Specialized carrier providing DEA-compliant shipping for controlled substances, including psilocybin-based investigational drugs. FedEx's regulatory expertise and tracking infrastructure are essential to trial-site supply continuity and audit compliance..

customers.name: Atai Life Sciences
customers.brainNodeRole: Sector Competitor — Psychedelic & Mental Health Portfolio
customers.relationshipNote: Diversified psychedelic-medicine holding company with portfolio of clinical-stage programs (Perception Neuroscience, Perception Neuroscience, others). ATAI's scale, capital access, and multi-program approach create competitive pressure on Cybin's funding and partnership opportunities. ATAI's market cap (~$1.5B as of 2024) and institutional backing signal sector maturation..

competitors.name: Compass Pathways PLC
competitors.relationshipNote: Leading psychedelic-assisted therapy company with Phase 2b COMP360 (psilocybin) program for treatment-resistant depression. Compass is further advanced clinically than Cybin; COMP360 is unmodified psilocybin, creating competitive differentiation via Cybin's deuteration IP. Compass's market cap (~$500M as of 2024) and clinical progress set valuation benchmarks for the sector. Disclosed in 10-K Item 1A competitive landscape.

competitors.name: MindMed Inc.
competitors.relationshipNote: Clinical-stage psychedelic company developing LSD-assisted therapy (MM120) for anxiety disorders and ADHD. MindMed's LSD platform is orthogonal to Cybin's psilocybin focus, but both compete for capital, clinical sites, and regulatory attention in the psychedelic sector. MindMed's Phase 2a program timeline and funding trajectory are material benchmarks for Cybin's capital-raise environment..

competitors.name: Usona Institute
competitors.relationshipNote: Non-profit research organization conducting IND-sponsored psilocybin research for treatment-resistant depression. Usona's non-profit structure and FDA-sponsored pathway create alternative regulatory route that may accelerate psilocybin approval independent of commercial biotech. Usona's clinical progress is material to Cybin's competitive timeline..

competitors.name: Eleusis Therapeutics
competitors.relationshipNote: Clinical-stage psychedelic company developing psilocybin-assisted therapy for treatment-resistant depression. Eleusis's program is similar in scope to Cybin's CYB003, creating direct competitive overlap..

regulators.name: U.S. Food and Drug Administration (FDA)
regulators.relationshipNote: Primary regulator for Cybin's IND applications, clinical trial oversight, and BLA pathway for CYB003 and CYB004. FDA granted Breakthrough Therapy Designation to CYB003 in 2021, accelerating review timelines. FDA feedback on pre-BLA meetings and clinical trial design is material to regulatory risk. Disclosed in 10-K Item 1A regulatory environment.

regulators.name: U.S. Drug Enforcement Administration (DEA)
regulators.relationshipNote: Regulator of psilocybin's Schedule I status and DEA licensing for manufacturing, distribution, and clinical use. DEA's willingness to grant manufacturing quotas and research licenses is critical to Cybin's supply-chain continuity. Changes in DEA policy or psilocybin scheduling could materially impact Cybin's business model..

regulators.name: U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission (SEC)
regulators.relationshipNote: Oversees Cybin's periodic reporting (10-Q, 10-K), material event disclosures (8-K), and proxy statements (DEF14A). SEC scrutiny of biotech clinical-stage disclosures and forward-looking statements is material to investor protection and litigation risk..

regulators.name: Health Canada (Therapeutic Products Directorate)
regulators.relationshipNote: Canadian regulator for Cybin's clinical trials and eventual market approval. Cybin has Canadian operations and may pursue parallel regulatory pathways in Canada to accelerate global commercialization. Health Canada's psilocybin policy and clinical-trial approval timelines are material to Cybin's international expansion strategy..

regulators.name: European Medicines Agency (EMA)
regulators.relationshipNote: Regulator for Cybin's potential European clinical trials and market approval. EMA's Advanced Therapy Designation or Accelerated Assessment pathways could expedite European approval timelines..

auditor.name: PricewaterhouseCoopers LLP (PwC)
auditor.relationshipNote: Big-Four auditor providing annual financial statement audits and internal control assessments for Cybin. PwC's audit opinions and any identified control deficiencies are material to investor confidence and regulatory compliance..

capitalProviders.name: Greenrose Capital
capitalProviders.relationshipNote: Early-stage venture capital firm with significant stake in Cybin; participated in Series B and subsequent funding rounds. Greenrose's continued support and follow-on investment capacity are material to Cybin's capital runway and valuation trajectory..

capitalProviders.name: Horizons ETFs Trust (PSYK — Psychedelic ETF)
capitalProviders.relationshipNote: Psychedelic-focused ETF holding Cybin as a core position. PSYK's flows and rebalancing decisions are material to Cybin's stock liquidity and valuation. PSYK's performance also signals broader sector sentiment and retail investor appetite for psychedelic therapeutics..

capitalProviders.name: Merida Capital Partners
capitalProviders.relationshipNote: Specialized venture capital firm focused on psychedelic therapeutics and mental health. Merida's sector expertise and follow-on investment capacity are relevant to Cybin's funding strategy..

capitalProviders.name: Institutional Investors (Passive Index Holders)
capitalProviders.relationshipNote: Passive index funds (Vanguard, BlackRock, State Street) holding Cybin as part of broad-market or biotech indices. Passive flows provide liquidity and valuation support but are price-insensitive. Cybin's inclusion in indices is material to stock liquidity and institutional ownership..

executiveTeam.name: Doug Drysdale
executiveTeam.title: Chief Executive Officer (CEO)
executiveTeam.relationshipNote: CEO and founder of Cybin; responsible for clinical strategy, regulatory pathway, capital allocation, and investor relations. Drysdale's background in biotech and psychedelic sector expertise are material to Cybin's credibility with FDA and investors..

marketSignals.name: Psychedelic Sector Sentiment Index (PSYK ETF Price Action)
marketSignals.relationshipNote: Horizons Psychedelic ETF (PSYK) price action and flows signal broader institutional appetite for psychedelic therapeutics. PSYK's correlation with Cybin stock is high; PSYK weakness signals sector-wide capital constraints and valuation pressure. PSYK's year-to-date performance is material to Cybin's funding environment and equity valuation..

marketSignals.name: Biotech IPO & SPAC Activity (Psychedelic Subsector)
marketSignals.relationshipNote: IPO and SPAC activity in psychedelic therapeutics (e.g., Compass Pathways IPO 2020, MindMed SPAC 2021) signal capital-market appetite for the sector. Slowdown in biotech IPO activity or psychedelic-specific SPAC deals would signal deteriorating funding environment and valuation pressure for Cybin..

marketSignals.name: FDA Breakthrough Designation Grant Rate (Psychedelic Programs)
marketSignals.relationshipNote: FDA's willingness to grant Breakthrough Therapy Designations to psychedelic programs signals regulatory openness and de-risking of the sector. Cybin's 2021 Breakthrough Designation for CYB003 is a positive signal; future FDA actions on competing programs (Compass, MindMed, Usona) will signal regulatory momentum..
